name: Ojisan o Datosu Made
original_name: 叔父さんを堕とすまで
source:
Spend a week at your uncle’s house in this short, choice-driven visual novel.
From time to time, a special "Pursue" button will appear, letting you move the story forward in unexpected ways.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3918960/]Steam[/url]]
